message: The other day, I found myself in the kitchen, caught up in a little cooking adventure (aka a small fire hazard). Thankfully, my smoke alarm was there to remind me to pay attention! It got me thinking about how we sometimes overlook the simple joys of fire safety — like having an escape plan. So, I gathered the kids for an old-fashioned family meeting. We drew out our escape routes and even made a fun game out of it! 🏃‍♀️ It was a great reminder that safety doesn't have to be all serious; it can bring us together in a totally fun way. How do you like to mix a little fun into preparedness?
